title: portfolio-ops config.yaml
description: Settings and vocabularies of a portfolio-ops data directory (business rules §4.2). A constraint inside an allOf entry that carries x-rule is enforced by that rule of the engine; everything else is shape, which the engine reports as 'schema'. A key whose value is empty counts as absent.

schema_version.description: Version of the data format. This engine reads version 1 (rule S6).

allow_public.description: Only true if this data may live in a public repository (rule S7). The files list risks, rejections and stalled projects; the default refuses a public repository.

stale_days.description: Days without progress on its next action after which an active product is stale (N2, L2).

actions_per_week.description: Next actions you expect to finish per week (L2).

wip_limit.description: Most products that may be active at once (L1, L2).

paused.description: Furthest a paused product's review_by may lie ahead (S4).

dormant.description: Furthest a dormant product's review_by may lie ahead (S4).

deferral_limit.description: Defer decisions after the latest next_action change that escalate a product (N3).

vocabularies.description: Extensions of the configurable vocabularies. Product statuses, risk severities and states, feeds_from modes and the built-in finding and decision types are fixed by the engine (rule S5).

contexts.description: Where risks apply and claims are used externally, for example website or app-store. 'all' is reserved (rule S5).

capabilities.description: What products and kernels can do; the idea gate compares ideas by these.

finding_types.description: Finding types beyond the built-in claim, for example name_check or metric.

decision_types.description: Decision types beyond the built-in admit, status_change, focus, defer and risk_accepted.

finding_ttl_days.description: Days a finding of each type stays valid when it has no expires_on (rule P2). Keys are finding types (rule S3).

account.description: The account scan (rules A1–A3), which runs only when PORTFOLIO_ACCOUNT_TOKEN is set.

ignore.description: Repositories that are not projects, written OWNER/NAME, where * and ? stand for any characters (rule S8); A1 leaves them out. Where a repository is named after a person, write a pattern rather than the name.

slugList.description: Vocabulary values: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, as in the built-in status_change. Ids (rule S1) do not allow underscores.
